purpose: Service review for WUP2025 rank 617 Cúcuta (city code 4895); city-bound registry evidence and safe anonymous parcel-geometry route.

registryBasis: Official San José de Cúcuta municipal sources identify the Subsecretaría de Gestión Catastral Multipropósito and the city cadastral portal. Its IDEEP open-data catalogue lists city parcel and building datasets with downloadable formats. This establishes local cadastral services and publicly advertised geometry products, but direct data retrieval and schema verification were blocked by an expired TLS certificate; no feature geometry or record values were downloaded.

officialSources.observation: Official municipal IDEEP landing identifies Cúcuta cadastral services, open data, metadata, and city map applications. Direct HTTPS request failed certificate verification; no bypass was used.

Official catalogue search result lists municipal San José de Cúcuta parcel datasets and KML/Excel/SHP formats. The host returned a certificate-expiry error on direct HTTPS GET, so actual file contents and field schema remain unverified.
Official city cadastral portal describes the cadastral-letter service; the form is parcel-number based and was not submitted.
Official spatial-data site describes cadastral-letter download by parcel number. No parcel number or query was submitted.
